days.instagram_theme: No Instagram post today: the LinkedIn book announcement
days.angle: Her first LinkedIn post: announce the debut book, A Self Repaired Soul: Journey That Heals, publishing soon.
lines: Two years of writing. One book.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper split by one lit gold kintsugi seam running top to bottom: something broken, mended with gold. The title is set large in gold foil beside it.
days.hook: Two years ago I started writing something I didn't tell many people about.
days.cta: Follow along if you'd like to be here when it's out.
days.caption:
Two years ago I started writing something I didn't tell many people about.

Most of it happened late at night, after the day was done. Some pages came easily. Some took a long time to feel right.

Today I can finally say it out loud.

My first book, A Self Repaired Soul: Journey That Heals, is publishing soon.

It's a book about healing and self-love. Not the polished kind. The kind where you put yourself back together slowly, and the cracks become the part you're proud of.

I'll share the road to launch here, honestly, as it happens.

If you'd like to be here when it's out, follow along. It would mean a lot.

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #MentalHealth #PersonalGrowth #Wellbeing

days.instagram_theme: If my book were a song, a season, a place, a person
days.angle: A magazine-style questionnaire page. She answers four questions about the book; the last answer is in her gold handwriting.
lines: If it were a song: your 1 a.m. playlist
A season: the first cool morning after summer
A place: the warm corner of your bed
A person: the friend who stays on the call till you fall asleep
days.visual: Cream off-white paper with flowing gold silk and drifting gold dust. Gold hero: a coiled gold telephone cord forming a heart, its end trailing to the last answer: the friend who stays on the call.
days.hook: If my book were a person, it would be the friend who stays on the call until you fall asleep.
days.cta: If your work were a season, which one would it be?
days.caption:
If my book were a person, it would be the friend who stays on the call until you fall asleep.

Doesn't fix anything. Doesn't give a speech. Just stays.

I answered four small questions about my book, and that last answer is the one I care about most. It's exactly what I want it to be for someone on a hard night.

Now your turn. Just one.

If your work were a season right now, which one would it be?

I'll read every answer.

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #Wellbeing #PersonalGrowth #MentalHealth

days.instagram_theme: The song you play when no one's home is healing too
days.angle: The song people play in the car or on the commute before walking into work.
lines: in the parking lot before work…
days.visual: Cream off-white paper with flowing gold silk and drifting gold dust. Gold hero: a gold equaliser rising like a sunrise over a gold horizon line, bars pulsing to the song.
days.hook: Everyone has a song they play in the parking lot before walking in.
days.cta: What's yours? One song, no explanation needed.
days.caption:
Everyone has a song they play in the parking lot before walking in.

The one that gets you through the first meeting. The one you replay twice on a bad Monday.

We don't call it self-care. But it is. Three minutes of being on your own side before the day asks for everything.

I think small things like this do more for us than we give them credit for.

Which song is yours? One song, no explanation needed.

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #Wellbeing #MentalHealth #Burnout

days.instagram_theme: Writing a book was never on my list
days.angle: Monday, career brain: the best thing she did was not in any plan.
lines: The one thing that mattered most
days.visual: Cream off-white paper with flowing gold silk and drifting gold dust. Gold hero: a grey dotted 'five-year plan' route with year pins; a gold path breaks off at Year 2 and curves to 'Write a book.'
days.hook: Writing a book was not in my five-year plan. Not even at the bottom.
days.cta: What's the best thing you've done that was never on your list?
days.caption:
Writing a book was not in my five-year plan. Not even at the bottom.

The plan had the sensible things. The things you write down when you want to look sorted.

And then the one thing that ended up mattering most showed up uninvited.

Two years later, it has a title and a finished manuscript.

I'm not saying throw away your plan. I'm saying leave a little room in it for the thing that finds you.

What's the best thing you've done that was never on your list?

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #PersonalGrowth #CareerAdvice #Wellbeing

days.instagram_theme: Pressed flower regains its colour; not the person who opened the first page
days.angle: How two years of writing changed the writer.
lines: I'm not the person who opened the first blank page.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper with flowing gold silk and drifting gold dust. Gold hero: a gold butterfly lifts out of an open book and rises with a trail of gold dust: it ended up rewriting me.
days.hook: I'm not the person who opened that first blank page two years ago.
days.cta: What have you worked on long enough that it changed you?
days.caption:
I'm not the person who opened that first blank page two years ago.

On day one, I just wanted to write a book. Somewhere in the middle, the book started asking more of me than I expected. By day 730, it was finished, and so was an older version of me.

Nobody tells you that a long project changes the person doing it. You start writing something, and it ends up rewriting you.

What have you worked on long enough that it changed you?

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #PersonalGrowth #MentalHealth #Wellbeing

days.instagram_theme: Seasons pass in a window, 2 a.m. rain, pages stack
days.angle: The unseen hours behind a first book.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper with flowing gold silk and drifting gold dust. Gold hero: A gold fountain-pen nib whose ink line becomes the gold underline beneath 'after midnight.'
days.hook:
Most of this book was written after midnight.
When the house was asleep and the phone finally stopped. Just me, a lamp, and the sentence I couldn't get right during the day.
days.cta: When do you do your best thinking?
days.caption:
Most of this book was written after midnight.

When the house was asleep and the phone finally stopped. Just me, a lamp, and the sentence I couldn't get right during the day.

Some nights the pages came. Some nights I wrote one line and deleted it.

Both counted.

I don't romanticise the tiredness. But there was something about those hours that made me honest on the page.

When do you do your best thinking?

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #PersonalGrowth #Wellbeing #MentalHealth

days.instagram_theme: Read this if sorry is the first word you say
days.angle: Over-apologising at work.
lines: Your feelings were never an inconvenience.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper with flowing gold silk and drifting gold dust. Gold hero: Rows of faint grey 'sorry' messages; gold lines strike through each row, then 'inconvenience.' lands in gold.
days.hook:
"Sorry, quick question."
"Sorry for the late reply."
"Sorry to bother you."
days.cta: Try one message today without the sorry. Tell me how it felt.
days.caption:
"Sorry, quick question."
"Sorry for the late reply."
"Sorry to bother you."

How many of those did you send this week?

Somewhere along the way, a lot of us learned to apologise just for taking up space. For asking. For needing a minute.

Your question was never a bother. Your reply didn't need to be faster. Your feelings were never an inconvenience.

Try one message today without the sorry. Notice how it feels. Then come tell me.

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #MentalHealth #Wellbeing #ImpostorSyndrome

days.instagram_theme: When you reach the last page, go a little easier on yourself
days.angle: What she wants a reader to feel, written as a short typed letter.
lines: When you reach the last page,
I hope you go a little easier on yourself.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper with flowing gold silk and drifting gold dust. Gold hero: A letter on cream paper with gilded gold edges; 'easier' set large in gold foil and her signature in gold.
days.hook:
Writers are told to know what they want a reader to feel.
Mine fits in six words: go a little easier on yourself.
days.cta: If a book could do one thing for you this year, what would it be?
days.caption:
Writers are told to know what they want a reader to feel.

Mine fits in six words: go a little easier on yourself.

Not fix everything. Not become a new person by Monday. Just be a little softer with the one you already are.

If someone closes my book and talks to themselves a bit more kindly that night, that's enough for me. That's the whole point.

If a book could do one thing for you this year, what would you want it to be?

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #MentalHealth #Wellbeing #PersonalGrowth

days.instagram_theme: Grey knot unravels into gold; you're allowed to choose you
days.angle: Saying no without a long explanation.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper with flowing gold silk and drifting gold dust. Gold hero: three grey paragraphs collapse and vanish, leaving one huge gold-foil 'No.'
days.hook:
A no doesn't need a three-paragraph explanation.
I still catch myself writing the paragraphs. The reasons, the backup reasons, the apology at the end.
days.cta: What's the hardest thing for you to say no to?
days.caption:
A no doesn't need a three-paragraph explanation.

I still catch myself writing the paragraphs. The reasons, the backup reasons, the apology at the end.

What I'm learning: "I can't take this on right now" is a full sentence. The people who matter will understand. The ones who don't were only ever comfortable with your yes.

You're allowed to choose you.

What's the hardest thing for you to say no to?

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #Burnout #Wellbeing #Leadership

days.instagram_theme: What this book won't tell you
days.angle: Contrarian list: the clichés the book refuses to say.
lines: 5 things my book won't tell you
It sits with you through it.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper with flowing gold silk and drifting gold dust. Gold hero: 'Just be positive.' in faded plum with one heavy gold-foil brushstroke struck through it.
days.hook:
My book won't tell you to "just be positive."
I think we've all heard it enough.
days.cta: Which one have you heard the most?
days.caption:
My book won't tell you to "just be positive."

I think we've all heard it enough.

When you're hurting, advice like that can make you feel like you're failing at feeling better. So I left it out, along with four others you'll find in this carousel.

What the book does instead is sit with you through it. No rushing. No silver linings on page one.

Which one have you heard the most?

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #MentalHealth #Wellbeing #PersonalGrowth

days.instagram_theme: Then: one text left on seen. Same text, softer you
days.angle: Overthinking a message, then and now.
lines: one message on 'seen' ran my whole night.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper with flowing gold silk and drifting gold dust. Gold hero: a jittery grey signal of overthinking calms and turns into one smooth gold wave.
days.hook: Then: one message left on "seen" could take over my whole night.
days.cta: What's one thing that used to shake you and doesn't anymore?
days.caption:
Then: one message left on "seen" could take over my whole night.

Now: same message, different me.

Nothing outside changed. The silence is still silence. What changed is how much power I give it.

Healing isn't always loud. Sometimes it's just noticing that the thing that used to shake you now passes through.

What used to shake you that doesn't anymore?

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #MentalHealth #PersonalGrowth #Wellbeing

days.instagram_theme: Rest before you're empty
days.angle: Burnout and back-to-back calendars, the biggest wellbeing topic on LinkedIn right now.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper with flowing gold silk and drifting gold dust. Gold hero: A gold metal hourglass; the sand pours, then it tips onto its side and the sand stops. Rest in gold.
days.hook:
We schedule meetings, deadlines and launches.
Almost nobody schedules rest before they need it.
days.cta: Have you blocked any time for yourself this week?
days.caption:
We schedule meetings, deadlines and launches.

Almost nobody schedules rest before they need it.

We treat rest like a reward. Something you earn once the list is done. But the list is never done, and the sand keeps falling.

Rest isn't the prize at the end. It's what lets you reach the end at all.

Have you blocked any time for yourself this week? Even an hour counts.

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #Burnout #Wellbeing #Leadership

lines: Some words take two years to get right.

days.hook:
Some words take two years to get right.
The first page of my book is staying sealed until launch day.
days.cta: Do you read the first page of a book before you buy it?
days.caption:
Some words take two years to get right.

The first page of my book is staying sealed until launch day.

Because a first page is a promise. It tells the reader whether they're safe here. I wanted mine to feel like someone opening the door before you even knock.

You'll read it soon.

Do you read the first page of a book before you buy it?

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #PersonalGrowth #Wellbeing #MentalHealth

This app is full of announcements.

New roles. Promotions. Launches. All of it real, and all of it worth celebrating.

But if you close it some days feeling behind, this one is for you.

Maybe you were busy getting through something nobody posts about. Maybe this year was about surviving, not announcing.

That counts. It always did.

Save this for the next scroll that makes you feel slow.

days.instagram_theme: A line from the book: the roots behind it
days.angle: Leaders and colleagues notice the change in someone, rarely the reason.
lines: We wonder why someone isn't quite themselves anymore…
without ever seeing the roots behind it.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper with flowing gold silk and drifting gold dust. Gold hero: A small green sprout above pastel soil; below it a full system of glowing gold roots: what we don't see.
days.hook:
We notice when someone at work changes.
They stop speaking up in meetings. They reply slower. They stop joining lunch.
days.cta: Who checked on you when you weren't yourself?
days.caption:
We notice when someone at work changes.

They stop speaking up in meetings. They reply slower. They stop joining lunch.

We notice the change. We rarely ask about the roots.

There's a line in my book I keep coming back to: we wonder why someone isn't quite themselves anymore, without ever seeing the roots behind it.

Sometimes the kindest thing a colleague or a leader can do is ask, once and gently, "How are you, really?" and then actually listen.

Who checked on you when you weren't yourself?

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #Leadership #MentalHealth #Wellbeing

days.instagram_theme: I miss the version of me who…
days.angle: Her line about herself, 'a kid at heart', and the version of us work tends to bury.
lines: I miss the version of me who…
She's waiting for me to let her play again.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper with flowing gold silk and drifting gold dust. Gold hero: An instant photo develops from grey into pastel colour; the swing inside is gold and starts to move.
days.hook:
I call myself a kid at heart.
Some weeks I forget to act like one.
days.cta: What did ten-year-old you want to be?
days.caption:
I call myself a kid at heart.

Some weeks I forget to act like one.

Somewhere between deadlines and grown-up worries, the version of us who played without a reason gets put away. She isn't gone. She's waiting for us to let her play again.

This weekend, do one thing just because you used to love it. No goal. No productivity.

What did ten-year-old you want to be?

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #Wellbeing #MentalHealth #PersonalGrowth

One word. No explanation.

days.caption:
One word. No explanation.

What does healing feel like for you?

I'll go first in the comments. Then I'd love to read yours.

Some words will be big. Some will be small and ordinary. All of them count.

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #MentalHealth #Wellbeing #PersonalGrowth

days.instagram_theme: Then: couldn't talk about it without crying. That's how I knew it had healed
days.angle: What healing actually looks like from the outside.
lines: I couldn't talk about it without crying.
I can tell the story. That's how I knew.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper with flowing gold silk and drifting gold dust. Gold hero: A crumpled sheet smooths open; its creases are mended with gold kintsugi seams.
days.hook:
Healing didn't look like forgetting.
It looked like being able to tell the story without falling apart.
days.cta: Have you got a story like this?
days.caption:
Healing didn't look like forgetting.

It looked like being able to tell the story without falling apart.

For a long time, there are things you can't say out loud without your voice giving way. Then one day you tell it, and your voice holds. The creases are still there. They just don't run you anymore.

That's how you know.

Have you had a moment like this?

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #MentalHealth #PersonalGrowth #Wellbeing

days.instagram_theme: Smiled in a photo on your worst day
days.angle: The team photo, the offsite picture, the profile picture.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper with flowing gold silk and drifting gold dust. Gold hero: a gold smile over a faint grey frown in an instant photo, with one small gold tear.
days.hook: Every team photo has at least one person smiling through their worst week.
days.cta: Check on someone today. Even a one-line message counts.
days.caption:
Every team photo has at least one person smiling through their worst week.

Sometimes it's the one holding the camera.

We get so good at looking fine at work. The smile, the "all good", the camera-on voice.

If you've been that person, I see you. If you work next to that person, you might never know it.

Check on someone today. A one-line message is enough.

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #MentalHealth #Leadership #Wellbeing

days.instagram_theme: Sometimes a little space is what softens it
days.angle: Hard conversations at work and at home: not all of them have to happen today.
lines: Everyone says: fix it right now.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper with flowing gold silk and drifting gold dust. Gold hero: two gold ribbons twisted tight like a rope slowly loosen into two calm waves with space between them.
days.hook:
Not every hard conversation has to happen today.
Some go better tomorrow.
days.cta: Do you talk it out straight away or take a day?
days.caption:
Not every hard conversation has to happen today.

Some go better tomorrow.

We're told to fix it right now, before bed, before the meeting ends. But when emotions are high, a little space is often what softens it. You come back calmer, kinder, and actually able to listen.

Space isn't walking away. It's giving the conversation a better chance.

Do you talk it out straight away, or take a day?

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #Leadership #Wellbeing #MentalHealth

days.instagram_theme: Send this to the friend who…

lines: Send this to the colleague who…
This book is for both of you.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper with flowing gold silk and drifting gold dust. Gold hero: Two paper cups; their steam rises in gold and meets as a heart.
days.hook:
Every workplace has one person who makes it survivable.
The one who asks if you've eaten. Who covers for you without asking why. Who notices you're off before you say a word.
days.cta: Tag them. They should know.
days.caption:
Every workplace has one person who makes it survivable.

The one who asks if you've eaten. Who covers for you without asking why. Who notices you're off before you say a word.

They rarely get thanked for it. It never shows up in a review.

So today, let's thank them here.

Tag yours. They should know.

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #Leadership #Wellbeing #MentalHealth

days.instagram_theme: Forgiven everyone except yourself
days.angle: Self-forgiveness after a mistake.
lines: Read this if you've forgiven everyone
days.visual: Cream off-white paper with flowing gold silk and drifting gold dust. Gold hero: a porcelain heart that cracks and is mended with gold kintsugi.
days.hook: Most of us forgive other people's mistakes faster than our own.
days.cta: Save this for the nights you're hard on yourself.
days.caption:
Most of us forgive other people's mistakes faster than our own.

A colleague slips up and we say, "It happens." We slip up and replay it for a week.

The version of you who made that mistake did the best she could with what she knew then.

Start with her.

Save this for the nights you're hard on yourself.

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #ImpostorSyndrome #MentalHealth #Wellbeing

days.angle: Why readers will recognise themselves without any real names.
lines: Every name in my book is made up.
Every feeling in it is real.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper with flowing gold silk and drifting gold dust. Gold hero: faint 'made-up names' fade away while a gold fingerprint draws itself ridge by ridge: every feeling is real.
days.hook:
Every name in my book is made up.
Every feeling in it is real.
days.cta: Have you ever read a book that felt like it knew you?
days.caption:
Every name in my book is made up.

Every feeling in it is real.

The names are invented. The feelings aren't. Some of them took me a long time to understand before I could write them down.

I think that's why the book might feel familiar when you read it. Different names. Feelings you've probably had too.

Have you ever read a book that felt like it knew you?

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #MentalHealth #PersonalGrowth #Wellbeing

We celebrate launch day.

days.cta: What small thing did you do for yourself today?
days.caption:
We celebrate launch day.

Nobody posts the hundred ordinary days before it.

The glass of water. The walk. The early night. The day you just got through. None of them look like progress on their own.

But that's what healing is made of. Honestly, it's what my book was made of too. One ordinary day at a time.

What small thing did you do for yourself today? Even the water counts.

#ASelfRepairedSoul #TrulyAariya #Wellbeing #PersonalGrowth #MentalHealth

No announcement. No progress photo. Just late nights and a lot of pages nobody saw.

What are you building that nobody can see yet?
